THREE FINDINGS WORTH THE NEXT LANE'S TIME. (1) THE MASK. +0x230 target `slwi r17,r18,3` = `rlwinm r17,r18,3,0,28` (mask 0xFFFFFFF8) against ours `rlwinm r17,r18,3,13,28` (mask 0x0007FFF8); identical rA, rS, SH and Rc. The obligation is the mask delta 0xFFF80000 rotated back by SH=3, i.e. source bits 16..28 = 0x1FFF0000, and it is discharged from the byte stream: +0x21c `lbz r21,0(r19)` (r21 bits 8..31 zero) -> +0x228 `addi r18,r21,0` (copy carries the fact) -> +0x22c `rlwimi r18,r17,8,23,23` (writes bit 8 only), so r18 is provably 9 bits wide on every path. (2) THE COMPOSITION WAS NEVER BLOCKED BY WHAT IT LOOKED LIKE. The superseded record reports the run-28 union-resweep provers returning `refuses -- no proved composition` with 1 UNABSORBED WORD IN 1 CLUSTER; that word was +0x230. Absorbing it leaves an ordinary transposition: ours +0xc8 `addi r17,r26,0` is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the target's +0xd8 word, the two `addi` copies are simply emitted in the opposite order, and the three words between them are identical in both streams. A single window [0xc8,0xdc) order [4,1,2,3,0], relocation-free on both sides, passes the dependence audit and verify_consistent_recolor then passes on the permuted, mask-corrected body. GENERAL LESSON: a prover that reports N unabsorbed words is reporting a CLASS GAP, and closing the gap can unblock a composition that looked independent of it — re-run the union provers over their old refusals whenever a class ships. (3) A REFUTED HYPOTHESIS, recorded so nobody spends the probe. The recolor refusal reads `+0xc8: use of g26 is not value-equal to g21`, which is the live-zero-remat signature, and the obvious next capability — a constant-value substitution for value_equality_recolor — would NOT have closed it. Measured with prove_constant_dataflow on both streams: our r26 IS provably 0 at +0xc8 while the target's r21 is NOT provably 0 there, and the only `li rX,0` preceding the site in EITHER stream is the shared +0xc0 `li r26,0`. The refusal was a fact about instruction ORDER, not about values (AGENTS discipline 14: instrument the guard before recording its refusal as a cap).
